name: howhot-weather-app
description: Weather visualization app with temperature history

scripts.dev: bash -c 'source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use --silent 22 && cd worker && npx wrangler dev --remote --port 8787'
scripts.dev:frontend: bash -c 'source $HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use --silent 22 && cd frontend && npm run dev'
scripts.dev:all: bash -c 'npm run dev & npm run dev:frontend & npm run dev:ci & wait'
